plain: A neutral person who settles a dispute

webster.text: A person chosen by a party, or by the parties who have a controversy, to determine their differences.

more.text: In a more extensive sense, an arbiter; one who has the power of deciding or prescribing without control.

example.quote: These contests require some arbitrator to determine them.
example.cite: James Otis, The Rights of the British Colonies Asserted and Proved (Boston, 1764)
